Title: mod (
Description:
mod returns the modulus (i.e. remainder) of the division dividend/divisor.
    If the divisor is zero the SQL error 22012 "Division by zero" is generated.
mod(35,3)			-> 2
mod(35,-3)			-> 2
mod(-35,3)			-> -2
mod(-35,-3)			-> -2
mod(3,35)			-> 3
mod(0,7)			-> 0
mod(60,3)			-> 0
